items.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Raised Guidance, Is The Pullback A Valuation Gap?
items.summary: Quanta Services (PWR) just paired a strong third quarter earnings release with higher full year 2026 revenue guidance, while management flagged ongoing acquisition opportunities and record infrastructure demand as key drivers of the updated outlook. The upbeat guidance comes after a sharp pullback in Quanta Services’ shares, with the stock down 29.25% on a 1 month share price basis and 24.23% over 3 months. items.title: Caterpillar Sinks Another 6%, Vertiv Down 14%, Quanta Down 12% as AI Selloff Spreads to Industrials
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCaterpillar fell 6% today as the AI selloff spread from chip and storage stocks like Western Digital to industrials like Vertiv and Quanta Services. Investors are selling Caterpillar as a data-center stock, though power generation was 15% of its 2025 sales and revenues, and the selling looks overdone.
